labels.name: area:uv
labels.description: uv adapter, Python and dependency management

issues.title: [core] Define Pyfaro scope, command contract and architecture ADR
issues.summary: Document what Pyfaro owns versus delegates (uv, Ruff, ty, pytest), compatibility rules and command naming.
acceptance: ADR merged with CLI command matrix and exit-code semantics
Explicitly forbid a second dependency resolver or lockfile
Decision on external tool management and reproducibility

issues.title: [cli] Bootstrap the Rust CLI workspace
issues.summary: Create a buildable Rust CLI with modular subcommands, global flags and useful help.
acceptance: `pyfaro --help` and `pyfaro --version` work
Unknown commands return non-zero with a helpful message
Release and debug builds succeed on Linux, macOS and Windows

issues.title: [config] Parse and validate [tool.pyfaro] in pyproject.toml
issues.summary: Define typed configuration and meaningful errors for invalid user settings.
acceptance: Supports default values, path resolution and schema validation
Respects existing [tool.ruff], [tool.ty] and other tool sections
No new standalone project metadata file required

issues.title: [core] Detect project roots and execution context
issues.summary: Find the closest valid Python project without changing the current directory.
acceptance: Walks ancestors to find pyproject.toml
`--project <path>` overrides discovery
Handles nested directories and symlinks deterministically

issues.title: [core] Build a cross-platform subprocess runner
issues.summary: Implement safe process execution to delegate to external tools.
acceptance: Preserves exit codes and forwards environment appropriately
Supports streaming stdout/stderr and Ctrl-C cancellation
Never invokes a shell implicitly for tool adapters

issues.title: [core] Discover uv and other tool versions
issues.summary: Resolve uv, ruff, ty and pytest paths and report missing or incompatible tools.
acceptance: Discovery respects virtual environments and PATH
Version information is reported consistently
Missing tools produce actionable errors, without unexpected installation

issues.title: [ci] Set up Rust checks and multi-OS CI
issues.summary: Protect trunk with formatting, Clippy, unit tests and smoke builds.
acceptance: CI matrix covers Linux, macOS and Windows
Rustfmt, Clippy and tests gate merging
No credentials committed to repository

issues.title: [docs] Add project governance and issue templates
issues.summary: Make the repository contributor-ready.
acceptance: README explains goals and non-goals
License, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT and SECURITY files provided
Bug report, feature request and pull-request templates available

issues.title: [testing] Create fixture-based CLI integration test harness
issues.summary: Introduce disposable Python project fixtures and subprocess assertions.
acceptance: Tests run without polluting user environment
Fixtures cover success and failure output and exit codes
CI executes smoke fixtures across supported OSes

issues.title: [uv] Implement the uv process adapter
issues.summary: Delegate package and environment operations to uv with version-aware command construction.
acceptance: uv output and exit codes propagate correctly
Argument passing is safe on all OSes
Integration tests use a pinned uv version

issues.title: [templates] Implement `pyfaro create` for libraries
issues.summary: Generate a valid src-layout library project with Pyfaro defaults.
acceptance: Creates pyproject.toml, src, tests and README
Accepts name, target directory and Python version
Generated project can sync, test and build

issues.title: [templates] Implement `pyfaro create` for CLIs
issues.summary: Generate an installable Python command-line project.
acceptance: Produces valid console_scripts entry point
Supports package and command naming
Template passes Pyfaro checks

issues.title: [config] Implement `pyfaro init` for existing projects
issues.summary: Opt in existing pyproject.toml projects without destructive changes.
acceptance: Shows proposed modifications before applying
Preserves third-party tool configuration and dependencies
A second run is idempotent

issues.title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro add` and `pyfaro remove`
issues.summary: Expose dependency changes through uv, including groups and development dependencies.
acceptance: Supports dependency specifiers and --dev
Updates pyproject.toml and uv.lock via uv
Returns useful solver errors

issues.title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro sync` and reproducible mode
issues.summary: Synchronize project dependencies and support frozen/locked workflows.
acceptance: Default sync is delegated to uv
`--locked` refuses stale lock state
Does not maintain an independent lockfile

issues.title: [cli] Implement `pyfaro run` with argument passthrough
issues.summary: Run scripts and commands in the project environment.
acceptance: Preserves all arguments after `--`
Executes inside the project environment
Propagates command failures and exit codes

issues.title: [uv] Expose Python version management via uv
issues.summary: Provide thin wrappers for listing, installing and pinning interpreters.
acceptance: `pyfaro python list|install|pin` delegates to uv
Obeys requires-python and .python-version
No custom Python installer or runtime cache

issues.title: [cli] Implement `pyfaro doctor` environment diagnostics
issues.summary: Explain problems with interpreters, tools, project layout and configuration.
acceptance: Reports Python, uv and relevant tool versions
Identifies conflicting configuration and missing dependencies
Exits non-zero for blocking issues

issues.title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro lint` with Ruff
issues.summary: Lint configured project files by invoking Ruff.
acceptance: Uses project Ruff configuration unchanged
Supports target paths and normal exit codes
Clearly reports when Ruff is unavailable

issues.title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro fmt` with Ruff
issues.summary: Expose Ruff formatting and non-mutating verification mode.
acceptance: `pyfaro fmt` writes format changes
`pyfaro fmt --check` never modifies files
Uses project exclusions and Ruff settings

issues.title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro type` with ty
issues.summary: Run ty check in the resolved project environment.
acceptance: Resolves project dependencies for type analysis
Passes explicit paths and preserves ty diagnostics
Documents limitations and supported ty version

issues.title: [quality] Implement non-destructive `pyfaro check`
issues.summary: Run formatting verification, lint and type checking as one quality gate.
acceptance: Runs Ruff format --check, Ruff lint and ty check
Does not modify source files by default
Aggregate non-zero exit on any failure; readable summary

issues.title: [quality] Add explicit `pyfaro check --fix`
issues.summary: Apply supported safe formatter and linter fixes on request.
acceptance: Never fixes source files without --fix
Explains which checks can automatically fix issues
Reruns verification and reports remaining issues

issues.title: [testing] Implement `pyfaro test` with pytest
issues.summary: Run pytest through the project environment.
acceptance: `pyfaro test` invokes pytest with correct cwd
Forwards filters, marker arguments and test paths
Returns pytest exit code and works in CI

issues.title: [templates] Ship pinned quality and test defaults
issues.summary: New projects opt in to known-working Ruff, ty and pytest versions.
acceptance: Generated templates include dev dependency group and lockfile instructions
Tool configs are owned by their standard pyproject sections
`pyfaro check` and `pyfaro test` pass immediately

issues.title: [testing] Test quality commands on real fixtures
issues.summary: Cover success, failures, exclusions and no-write-by-default.
acceptance: Fixtures include library and CLI projects
Tests assert check never writes files and --fix is explicit
Pyfaro returns consistent codes for lint/type/test failures

issues.title: [templates] Add FastAPI project preset
issues.summary: Generate a small functional FastAPI application with tests.
acceptance: Preset includes application entry point and smoke test
Project works with create, dev, check and test
Dependencies are managed through uv

issues.title: [dev] Implement process supervisor for `pyfaro dev`
issues.summary: Run a long-lived development process with clean lifecycle management.
acceptance: Ctrl-C stops child processes without orphaning
Correct environment and working directory
Exit errors surface clearly

issues.title: [dev] Add FastAPI dev runner and reload
issues.summary: Start Uvicorn with an appropriate reload configuration for FastAPI presets.
acceptance: `pyfaro dev` starts the template app
Edits trigger reload and syntax errors are visible
No second bespoke filesystem watcher for FastAPI

issues.title: [config] Configure dev entry point and arguments
issues.summary: Add [tool.pyfaro.dev] settings for project-specific development commands.
acceptance: Supports entry point, arguments and reload switch
Explicit setting takes precedence over preset
Invalid values are detected before launch

issues.title: [tasks] Specify safe task invocation semantics
issues.summary: Define shell/no-shell behavior, quoting, cancellation and environment handling.
acceptance: Documented resolution of tasks vs executable programs
Explicit opt-in for shell constructs and no implicit shell injection
Cross-platform escaping semantics tested

issues.title: [tasks] Implement named custom tasks
issues.summary: Support named commands configured under [tool.pyfaro.tasks].
acceptance: `pyfaro run <task>` executes a named task
Task and program names cannot collide silently
Explicit cwd and environment fields are supported

issues.title: [dev] Improve live development logs and errors
issues.summary: Provide legible prefixed logs, signal handling and startup diagnostics.
acceptance: stdout/stderr remains readable and Ctrl-C reliable
Failure to bind a port produces useful guidance
Verbose mode reveals invoked command

issues.title: [docs] Write end-to-end FastAPI getting-started guide
issues.summary: Document the workflow from install to a running app and passing CI.
acceptance: Tutorial demonstrates create, add, dev, check, test and build
Examples work on at least Linux and Windows
Known prerequisites and tool versions documented

issues.title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro build` using uv build
issues.summary: Build Python wheels and sdists without reimplementing packaging.
acceptance: Supports wheel and sdist artifacts
Preserves PEP 517/518 build-backend configuration
Validates generated artifacts in CI

issues.title: [distribution] Build standalone Pyfaro executables
issues.summary: Produce reproducible release artifacts for supported platforms.
acceptance: Artifacts for Linux x86_64, macOS x86_64/aarch64, and Windows x86_64
Artifacts contain CLI and display version
Checksums published alongside archives

issues.title: [distribution] Provide secure installation and upgrade path
issues.summary: Ship installation instructions/scripts and a clear path to install uv prerequisites.
acceptance: Documented installation on all supported OSes
Verify downloaded binaries/checksums; no silent unsafe installers
`pyfaro doctor` explains missing uv and offers actionable steps

issues.title: [cli] Add shell completion and friendly help
issues.summary: Improve interactive CLI discoverability.
acceptance: Supports Bash, Zsh and Fish completions
Top-level help includes realistic workflow examples
CLI flags documented consistently

issues.title: [core] Standardize error codes and verbose diagnostics
issues.summary: Expose consistent failures and command invocation traces for troubleshooting.
acceptance: Document stable exit codes (including tool forwarding rules)
`--verbose` displays tool versions and executed commands
Errors avoid leaking tokens or sensitive environment values

issues.title: [ci] Set up GitHub Releases and crates.io publication
issues.summary: Automate signed/tagged public pre-releases with documented ownership.
acceptance: Tag-to-release pipeline publishes verified artifacts
crate version and CLI version match release tag
Publish credentials minimized; release notes generated

issues.title: [docs] Publish CLI and configuration reference
issues.summary: Document all public commands and configuration defaults.
acceptance: Each command has usage, flags and exit codes
[tool.pyfaro] configuration examples are copyable
Installation and troubleshooting documented

issues.title: [security] Document data/privacy and install trust model
issues.summary: Set default-no-telemetry stance and identify download and execution trust boundaries.
acceptance: No telemetry or outbound reporting from Pyfaro by default
Document uv/network accesses distinctly
Explicit disclosure of third-party binaries and updates

issues.title: [core] Create supported-version compatibility matrix
issues.summary: Test supported Python/uv/Ruff/ty/pytest combinations and platforms.
acceptance: Maintained version support policy
CI matrix includes defined Python versions and OSes
Failures of pinned integration versions are detected

issues.title: [config] Validate existing-project interoperability
issues.summary: Ensure Pyfaro does not rewrite or break conventional uv-based Python projects.
acceptance: Existing pyproject.toml tool sections remain untouched
Sync/check/test work with common src layouts
No unnecessary changes to uv.lock or dependencies

issues.title: [security] Threat-model subprocesses and release supply chain
issues.summary: Harden process execution, binary supply and CI permissions.
acceptance: Argument injection, task shell opt-in and path traversal covered by tests
Checksums or attestations for release assets
Least-privilege permissions for release automation

issues.title: [core] Define backwards compatibility and deprecation policy
issues.summary: Freeze the public v1 command, configuration and output contracts.
acceptance: Compatibility guarantees for flags and [tool.pyfaro] documented
Breaking changes and deprecation mechanism defined
External tool versions and lock behavior spelled out

issues.title: [ci] Add end-to-end smoke matrix on clean machines
issues.summary: Verify first install, create, run, check, test and build without developer-specific setup.
acceptance: Smoke tests on clean Linux/macOS/Windows runners
New user flow executes from fresh checkout
No hidden PATH or local environment dependency

issues.title: [core] Establish baseline performance benchmarks
issues.summary: Measure CLI startup and representative workflows without inventing performance claims.
acceptance: Benchmarks cover startup, check, test and create
Results compared against direct underlying tools
Benchmarks published and regressions investigated

issues.title: [docs] Publish migration, troubleshooting and examples
issues.summary: Prepare complete public documentation for stable release.
acceptance: Migration guide for uv + Ruff + pytest projects
Examples for library, CLI and FastAPI workflows
Common failure modes and limitations documented

issues.title: [distribution] Ship Pyfaro 1.0 with changelog and support policy
issues.summary: Make stable release with verified install commands and stable docs.
acceptance: No unresolved milestone-blocking P0 defects
Versioned release notes and reproducible artifacts
Stable download instructions and support matrix published

issues.title: [workspaces] Discover uv workspace members
issues.summary: Use native uv workspaces rather than creating an independent package graph.
acceptance: Finds root and members from uv-compatible configuration
Determines active member from current directory
Clear errors for broken workspace definitions

issues.title: [workspaces] Add package-scoped command selection
issues.summary: Run check/test/tasks against selected workspace packages.
acceptance: Supports --package and --all where meaningful
Stable member selection and ordered output
Workspace filters do not alter uv workspace metadata

issues.title: [tasks] Define dependency-aware task DAG
issues.summary: Allow declared task dependencies and reject cycles.
acceptance: Supports depends-on links in task configuration
Cycle and missing-task errors name offending chain
Does not execute a task more than once per graph run

issues.title: [tasks] Execute independent tasks in parallel
issues.summary: Schedule task DAG with bounded concurrency.
acceptance: Configurable concurrency; deterministic failure summary
Cancel remaining work on Ctrl-C
No accidental interleaving that obscures task identity

issues.title: [tasks] Add opt-in local content-addressed task cache
issues.summary: Avoid repeating deterministic tasks when declared inputs are unchanged.
acceptance: Cache key includes inputs, config and toolchain versions
Tasks declare outputs; side-effect tasks are uncached by default
Manual --no-cache switch and explainable hits/misses

issues.title: [tasks] Implement cache safety and invalidation tests
issues.summary: Verify stale artifacts, environmental changes and deletion do not cause false hits.
acceptance: Changed inputs and tool versions invalidate cache
Missing or altered outputs cause reruns
Cache corruption falls back to normal execution

issues.title: [tasks] Add `pyfaro tasks list|graph` inspector
issues.summary: Help developers understand declared tasks and task ordering.
acceptance: List displays task summary and source config
Graph displays dependencies and detects cycles
Text output works without terminal UI

issues.title: [ci] Demonstrate incremental monorepo checks in CI
issues.summary: Document repeatable multi-package checks and caching.
acceptance: Example workspace project with shared library and API
CI example runs selective checks and tests
Explains why uv caches and task caches are different

issues.title: [agents] Specify a versioned JSON output contract
issues.summary: Define machine-readable results for check, test, doctor and tasks.
acceptance: Schema defines tool version, command, status and structured errors
Schema has explicit version field and backwards-compatibility rules
No parsing ANSI terminal output to produce JSON

issues.title: [agents] Implement `--output json` across diagnostics
issues.summary: Expose structured results consistently to tools and agents.
acceptance: check/test/doctor support JSON where adapters expose data
stdout valid JSON; human-friendly logs on stderr when needed
Exit codes remain meaningful

issues.title: [agents] Normalize file diagnostics and source locations
issues.summary: Convert available Ruff/ty/pytest information into a shared diagnostic model.
acceptance: Includes severity, message, tool and file/range when available
Preserves upstream diagnostic details in an extension field
Missing source ranges are represented explicitly, not invented

issues.title: [agents] Introduce changed-files quality checks
issues.summary: Check only affected paths when supported by underlying tools.
acceptance: Supports explicit path selection and optional git-based change discovery
Defines behavior for renames/deleted files
Does not claim sound incremental typing if dependencies require full project checking

issues.title: [agents] Provide CI-friendly annotations and SARIF export
issues.summary: Make normalized diagnostics consumable by code scanning interfaces.
acceptance: SARIF export documents supported fields
GitHub annotations point to correct source locations
Machine output tested against known fixtures

issues.title: [agents] Add agent-safe execution guidelines and examples
issues.summary: Document non-interactive operation and low-risk workflows for AI coding agents.
acceptance: Example AGENTS.md template and deterministic command sequence
No auto-fix without explicit request
Document which commands can write files or contact network

issues.title: [core] Draft RFC for future plugin/adapter API
issues.summary: Evaluate demand for alternate type checkers, test runners and framework adapters before committing to a public plugin API.
acceptance: RFC proposes extension points and versioning approach
Defines out-of-scope changes (no alternate lockfile/backend)
No public plugin API shipped without proven use cases
